title: Import projects
intro: Bring repositories, milestones, epics or projects from your tools into the portfolio. You choose which ones next.
trackers: From your issue trackers (kept in sync)
another: Or from a tool, imported once
whatLabel: What becomes a project in Ronde

modeHints.repos: Each project takes the repository’s name, and its tickets come up in meetings. Best when each repository is a product or a service.
modeHints.milestones: Each project is named “repository · milestone” and takes its due date and progress. Best when milestones are deliverables.

fields.projectHint: The letters before the number in its issue keys: OPS in OPS-42.

tokenOptional.gitlab: Access token (only for private groups or projects)

tokenHint.github: Leave it empty for public repositories. For private ones: a <link>fine-grained token</link> that can read them (and their Issues, for milestones).
tokenHint.gitlab: Leave it empty for public projects. For private ones: a personal or project access token with the read_api scope.
tokenHint.gitlabGroup: Leave it empty for public groups. For a private one: a personal or group access token with the read_api scope.
tokenHint.jira: An <link>API token</link> of the account whose email is above.
tokenHint.linear: A personal API key, created in your Linear settings.

tokenNotKept: It serves this import only: Ronde does not keep it.
teamHint: With the Team plan, projects imported through a saved issue tracker stay in sync with the tool: name, status, dates and progress.
syncHowTo: To keep imported projects in sync, first add the tool to the issue trackers in the <link>workspace settings</link>, then import from it.
syncAskAdmin: Projects stay in sync when an administrator of the workspace imports them through its issue trackers. What you import here is imported once.
allImported: Everything listed is already in the portfolio.

partial.tracker: Only what the issue tracker’s token can read is listed.
partial.public: Without a token, only public ones are listed.

keepSyncHint: Their name, status, dates and progress follow the tool every hour; the rest stays yours to edit.
keepSyncHintRepo: Their name follows the tool every hour, and they are marked done once archived; the rest stays yours to edit.
onceHint: Imported once: they are edited in Ronde from then on.
offline: Ronde could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
